justification: Image A shows a horizontal relief panel with arched motifs above and small animal figures below arranged in a narrative frieze, while Image B shows a single freestanding anthropomorphic stone figure with carved facial and body features and a circular disc motif on the torso. The only loose commonality is that both use low-relief carving on stone to depict figural content, but the subject matter (narrative animal frieze vs. a standing humanoid figure with body ornamentation) and arrangement are fundamentally different.
